item.subject: maths
item.stem:
The diagram shows quadrilateral $WXYZ$. Chetan measures $\angle W = \angle X = \angle Y = \angle Z = 90^\circ$.

Which two claims are correct?

options.A: Yes: a quadrilateral with all angles $90^\circ$ is a rectangle; opposite-side equalities then follow.
options.B: He should call the figure a right angle, not a rectangle.
options.C: Opposite sides of $WXYZ$ are equal as a consequence, so he need not check them separately to classify it as a rectangle.
options.D: Yes, even if $W$, $X$, $Y$, $Z$ were only three rays and not a closed quadrilateral.
